what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Romania in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 7877 Romanian asylum seekers, and the United States hosted 72.0% of them.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Romania, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 2466 asylum seekers, and the figure fell to a low in 2010.
It then rose, reaching its highest point, 8952, at the end of 2024; the main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
